name: Bugzilla Links
description: Personal Bugzilla link previews with per-user permissions and caching.

settings_schema.header: Public bugs work without a Bugzilla account. Personal API keys are entered privately by each user via the main menu. Set the encryption secret outside the database before connecting personal accounts.

settings.help_text: HTTPS URL of your Bugzilla server, e.g. https://bugzilla.altlinux.org. REST API must be reachable from Mattermost.
Bugzilla 5.2 uses the api_key query parameter. Never log upstream query strings. Use header only when your Bugzilla supports X-BUGZILLA-API-KEY.

Optional absolute path readable by the plugin, containing a base64-encoded 32-byte secret. Alternatively set MM_BUGZILLA_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE or MM_BUGZILLA_ENCRYPTION_KEY. The secret itself is never saved in plugin settings.
